title: Ucingo oluye lwadlula iminyaka
intro: Cabanga ngomphefumulo omi wodwa umelene nempucuko yonke, uzimisele ukuwuqondisa emuva ekudukisweni ngesinqumo esiqinile. Sekungamakhulu eminyaka, umyalezo wenqatshwa, wahlekwa usulu, futhi walahlwa—kodwa umzamo awuzange uphele. Ekugcineni, kwafika ukubalwa okukhulu, futhi bambalwa kuphela abathola insindiso kanye nalomphefumulo oqinile. Ungawubona lo mfanekiso ku-Quran?
clues: Ngathunyelwa njengomxwayisi kubantu abalahlekile ngezindlela zabo.
Ngabamema ukuba bacele intethelelo futhi baphenduke eziphambekweni zabo, kodwa baphenduka.
Ngaphansi komyalo kaNkulunkulu, ngakha umkhumbi omkhulu ngenkathi abantu bakithi bengibuka futhi bengihleka usulu.
Ngabiza iNkosi yami ngokungaphezi—ekugcineni yaphendula, futhi amanzi ageleza esibhakabhakeni ngezikhukhula.
Ngangena esikebheni nalabo abakholwa lapho amanzi kazamcolo ephakama ngaphezu komhlaba.
Ngamemeza komunye owayesele ngemuva, ngibacela ukuba baphephele entabeni, kodwa isinqumo sase sidlulile.
